name: intentrax-execution-assurance
description: Execution assurance for agent-built apps: find consequential agent actions, wire admission -> execution -> verification with the Intentrax SDK, and verify proofs read-only. Bundles the read-only Intentrax MCP proof server.

tenant_read_api_key.title: Intentrax tenant read API key (optional)
tenant_read_api_key.description: Only needed for the intentrax_read_tenant_proof tool. Use a least-privilege, read-only key. Leave empty to use keyless public verification only.

tenant_id.title: Intentrax tenant ID (optional)
tenant_id.description: Tenant whose proofs intentrax_read_tenant_proof may read. Leave empty to use keyless public verification only.
